description: Publishes an APK this workspace uploaded to AppForShare in the AppForShare Android store (upload track: the developer's own signed APK, badge "Uploaded by developer"; the source track stays "Built from source"). check: true (or no confirm) only answers what would happen: mode new (first listing), update (a newer version of the upload listing) or source (listed from source, push a tag instead), what we read from the APK, the problems with their fix (debug or test only build, target below API 24, versionCode not higher, another signing key than earlier releases, the spyware permission set, size over the plan), the sensitive permissions that need a reason, and the plan. To publish, ask the person first and pass confirm: true. A first listing needs summary (up to 80 characters), categories, privacyPolicyUrl and ratingAnswers (all none for an app without mature content, ask the person); an update needs nothing but an optional changelog. Every check runs before a release is made (signature v2/v3 with the developer key, package ownership); then the same automatic review as every store release runs (malware check, code scan, permissions, AI review); nothing waits for a person. A failed check answers check, message and fix. Every plan with an account; Developer role.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

categories.description: Store categories from options.categories of the check answer

check.description: true = only show what would happen (default when confirm is not true)

confirm.description: true = publish now (ask the person first)

permissionReasons.description: Why the app needs each sensitive permission, by id (SMS, CALL_LOG, CONTACTS, BACKGROUND_LOCATION, ACCESSIBILITY, OVERLAY, INSTALL_PACKAGES, DEVICE_ADMIN, NOTIFICATION_LISTENER, ALL_FILES)

ratingAnswers.description: violence, sexual, language, drugs, gambling, fear (none or a level), userInteraction, sharesLocation, purchases (booleans)

name: android_store_publish_upload
title: Publish an APK upload in the Android store
